tasks.title: The Effects of Urbanization on Bird Populations
paras: Urbanization has had a profound impact on bird populations worldwide. As cities expand, natural habitats are replaced with buildings, roads, and other infrastructure. This leads to a significant reduction in the availability of nesting sites and food sources for birds.

Some species, such as pigeons and sparrows, have adapted well to urban environments, taking advantage of the new resources and structures. However, many other species struggle to survive in these altered landscapes. Therefore, it is imperative to find solutions that help birds adapt to city life. One notable effect of urbanization is the change in bird song. Birds living in cities often sing at higher pitches and volumes than their rural counterparts. This adaptation helps them communicate over the noise of traffic and human activity. Additionally, the artificial lighting in cities can disrupt the natural circadian (daily time-related) rhythms of birds, affecting their breeding and feeding behaviors.

Conservationists are working to mitigate the negative effects of urbanization on birds. Initiatives such as creating urban green spaces, constructing bird-friendly buildings, and reducing light pollution are being implemented. These efforts aim to create a more hospitable environment for birds, allowing them to coexist with humans in urban settings.

questions.stem: The word “mitigate” in the passage is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: 题型：词汇题 原文定位：Conservationists are working to mitigate the negative effects…环保人士正努力______负面影响 mitigate = 减轻、缓解，和 reduce（减少） 意思最接近。 (A) understand 理解 (B) analyze 分析 (C) communicate 交流 (D) reduce 减少

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT mentioned as an effect of urbanization on birds in the passage?
questions.analysis: 题型：排除题（NOT mentioned） 题目：以下哪一项不是文中提到的城市化对鸟类的影响？ 原文定位：One notable effect of urbanization is the change in bird song......注意题干 NOT，原文只说食物变少，没说变多。 (A) 筑巢地减少 原文有：reduction in the availability of nesting sites (B) 鸟鸣变化 原文有：change in bird song (C) 食物来源增加 原文说食物减少，不是增加 (D) 昼夜节律被打乱 原文有：disrupt the natural circadian rhythms

questions.stem: Why does the author mention pigeons and sparrows?

options.A: To identify birds that struggle to survive in urban environment
options.B: To give examples of birds that have adjusted to living in urban settings
options.C: To highlight the diversity of urban bird species
options.D: To suggest that all birds can adapt to cities

questions.analysis: 题型：目的题 题目：作者为什么提到鸽子和麻雀？原文定位：Some species, such as pigeons and sparrows, have adapted well to urban environments…such as 永远是举例证明前面观点，前面观点是 “有些物种适应得很好”。 (A) 说明难以在城市生存的鸟 错误 (B) 举例适应城市环境的鸟 (C) 强调城市鸟类多样性 错误 (D) 暗示所有鸟都能适应城市 错误

questions.stem: What is one initiative mentioned in the passage to help birds in urban areas?

options.A: Introducing new bird species to urban areas
options.B: Providing human-made food sources to birds
options.D: Decreasing the amount of noise made by traffic

questions.analysis: 题型：细节题 题目：文中提到哪项帮助城市鸟类的措施？原文定位：Initiatives such as creating urban green spaces…原文直接给出措施，原词复现。 (A) 引入新鸟类 错误 (B) 提供人工食物 错误 (C) 建设城市绿地 (D) 减少交通噪音 （文中没提减少噪音，只说鸟调高音量）

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the impact artificial lighting in cities has on birds?

options.A: It disrupts the natural behaviors of birds.
options.B: It allows birds to find food at night.
options.C: It helps birds to adapt to urban environments.
options.D: It increases the population of urban birds.

questions.analysis: 题型：推断题 题目：关于城市人工照明对鸟类的影响，可以推断出什么？ 原文定位：artificial lighting… disrupt the natural circadian rhythms… affecting their breeding and feeding behaviors. disrupt rhythms = 打乱节律；affect breeding & feeding = 影响繁殖与觅食，都属于自然行为被干扰。 (A) 干扰鸟类自然行为 (B) 帮助夜间觅食 错误 (C) 帮助适应城市 错误 (D) 增加数量 错误
